import re, math

# login tokens
pw=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
simple_pw=[p['password'] for p in pw if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0];
split_pw=[p['password'] for p in pw if p['account_name']=='splitwise'][0];
phone_pw=[p['password'] for p in pw if p['account_name']=='phone'][0];

simple_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='connorbrow@gmail.com', password=simple_pw)['access_token']
split_token=apis.splitwise.login(username='connorbrow@gmail.com', password=split_pw)['access_token']
phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='5734599766', password=phone_pw)['access_token']

trip_notes={
 'Road Trip':3091,
 'Edinburgh Trip Expenses':3084,
 'Expenses made in the trip to Dubrovnik':3088,
 'Expenditures of Venice trip.':3089,
 'Expenditures of Moscow trip.':3085,
 'Tokyo Trip Expenses':3086,
 'Expenditures of Maui trip.':3090,
 'Expenses for the trip to Santorini':3087
}
trip_group_ids={
 'Road Trip':281,
 'Edinburgh Trip Expenses':274,
 'Expenses made in the trip to Dubrovnik':278,
 'Expenditures of Venice trip.':279,
 'Expenditures of Moscow trip.':275,
 'Tokyo Trip Expenses':276,
 'Expenditures of Maui trip.':280,
 'Expenses for the trip to Santorini':277,
}

# fetch phone contacts (all pages)
phone_contacts=[]
page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page: break
    phone_contacts.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit: break
    page_index += 1

# index contacts by first_name lower
contacts_by_first={}
for c in phone_contacts:
    fn=(c.get('first_name') or '').strip().lower()
    if not fn: continue
    contacts_by_first.setdefault(fn, []).append(c)

# fetch splitwise group members emails per trip group
group_members={}  # group_id -> list of members (name,email)
for trip,gid in trip_group_ids.items():
    g=apis.splitwise.show_group(group_id=gid, access_token=split_token)
    group_members[gid]=g.get('members',[])

# fetch notes contents
parsed=[]
expense_line_re=re.compile(r"^-\s*(?P<payer>.+?)\s+paid\s+\$(?P<amount>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s+for\s+\"(?P<desc>.+?)\"\.?\s*Owed equally by\s+(?P<debtors>.+?)\.?\s*$")

for trip,nid in trip_notes.items():
    note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=simple_token)
    content=note['content']
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        m=expense_line_re.match(line)
        if not m:
            raise ValueError(f'Failed to parse line in note {trip} (id {nid}): {line}')
        payer=m.group('payer').strip()
        amount=float(m.group('amount'))
        desc=m.group('desc').strip()
        debtors_raw=m.group('debtors').strip()
        # normalize debtors list: replace ' and ' with ',' then split by comma
        debtors_raw=debtors_raw.replace(' and ', ', ')
        debtors_raw=debtors_raw.replace(' & ', ', ')
        debtors=[d.strip() for d in debtors_raw.split(',') if d.strip()]
        parsed.append({
            'trip':trip,
            'group_id':trip_group_ids[trip],
            'note_id':nid,
            'source_line':line,
            'payer_name':payer,
            'paid_amount':amount,
            'description':desc,
            'debtor_names':debtors
        })

print('Parsed expenses:', len(parsed))

# collect unique first names
unique_names=set()
for e in parsed:
    unique_names.add(e['payer_name'].strip().split()[0].lower())
    for dn in e['debtor_names']:
        unique_names.add(dn.strip().split()[0].lower())

print('Unique first-name tokens in notes:', sorted(unique_names))

# resolve each first name to a specific contact email
name_resolution={}  # first_name_lower -> contact chosen
unresolved=[]

# precompute relevant group member emails for each first name based on appearances in notes
appear_groups_by_first={}
for e in parsed:
    # payer and debtors first tokens
    for role in ['payer','debtor']:
        pass
    for dn in [e['payer_name']] + e['debtor_names']:
        fn=dn.strip().split()[0].lower()
        appear_groups_by_first.setdefault(fn,set()).add(e['group_id'])

for fn in unique_names:
    candidates=contacts_by_first.get(fn,[])
    if len(candidates)==1:
        name_resolution[fn]=candidates[0]
        continue
    if len(candidates)==0:
        unresolved.append((fn,'no_phone_contact'))
        continue
    # if multiple, restrict by emails that appear among members of any groups where this name appears
    allowed_emails=set()
    for gid in appear_groups_by_first.get(fn,set()):
        for mem in group_members.get(gid,[]):
            allowed_emails.add(mem.get('email'))
    matched=[c for c in candidates if c.get('email') in allowed_emails]
    if len(matched)==1:
        name_resolution[fn]=matched[0]
    else:
        unresolved.append((fn, f'multiple_candidates {len(candidates)} matched {len(matched)}'))

print('Unresolved names:', unresolved)
if unresolved:
    raise SystemExit('Cannot resolve all names; aborting')

# create helper to map a full name token from note to email via first-name token

def note_name_to_email(name):
    fn=name.strip().split()[0].lower()
    c=name_resolution[fn]
    return c['email'], c

# Build verification table and also existing-expense matches

# Fetch existing expenses for each involved group (paginate fully)
existing_by_group={}
for gid in sorted(set(e['group_id'] for e in parsed)):
    existing=[]
    page_index=0; page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.splitwise.show_group_expenses(access_token=split_token, group_id=gid, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, deleted=False)
        if not page: break
        existing.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit: break
        page_index += 1
    existing_by_group[gid]=existing
    print('Existing expenses in group', gid, 'count', len(existing))

# verification + match check
verification_rows=[]
skip_count=0
create_count=0

for e in parsed:
    payer_email,_=note_name_to_email(e['payer_name'])
    debtor_emails=[note_name_to_email(dn)[0] for dn in e['debtor_names']]
    debtor_set=set(debtor_emails)

    # check for exact existing match
    match_found=False
    for ex in existing_by_group[e['group_id']]:
        if ex.get('description')!=e['description']:
            continue
        if float(ex.get('paid_amount',0))!=float(e['paid_amount']):
            continue
        if ex.get('payer',{}).get('email')!=payer_email:
            continue
        ex_debtor_set=set([s['debtor']['email'] for s in ex.get('shares',[])])
        if ex_debtor_set==debtor_set:
            match_found=True
            break

    verification_rows.append({
        'trip':e['trip'],
        'group_id':e['group_id'],
        'description':e['description'],
        'paid_amount':e['paid_amount'],
        'payer_email':payer_email,
        'debtor_emails':debtor_emails,
        'skip_due_to_existing':match_found,
        'source_line':e['source_line'],
    })
    if match_found:
        skip_count+=1
    else:
        create_count+=1

print('Create needed:', create_count, 'Skip existing:', skip_count)

# print compact verification table
for row in verification_rows:
    if row['skip_due_to_existing']:
        status='SKIP'
    else:
        status='CREATE'
    print(status, '|', row['trip'], '|', row['description'], '|', row['paid_amount'], '| payer', row['payer_email'], '| debtors', ','.join(row['debtor_emails']))
